source.note: Official DBE November 2020 Mathematics P2 marking guidelines (English/Afrikaans). Bilingual PDF; English transcribed only.

extraction.method: transcription from the official PDF text layer, checked against 140 dpi page renders

notes: If a candidate answers a question TWICE, only mark the FIRST attempt. If a candidate has crossed out an attempt of a question and not redone the question, mark the crossed out version. Consistent accuracy applies in ALL aspects of the marking memorandum. Stop marking at the second calculation error. Assuming answers/values in order to solve a problem is NOT acceptable. A mark for a correct statement (a statement mark is independent of a reason) is indicated by S. A mark for the correct reason (a reason mark may only be awarded if the statement is correct) is indicated by R. Award a mark if statement AND reason are both correct (S/R).

$\sqrt{3}\sin x+\cos x\geq 1$

$\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin x+\dfrac{1}{2}\cos x\geq\dfrac{1}{2}$

$\sin x\cos 30^{\circ}+\cos x\sin 30^{\circ}\geq\dfrac{1}{2}$

$\sin(x+30^{\circ})\geq\dfrac{1}{2}$

$\sin(x+30^{\circ})=\dfrac{1}{2}$ at $x=0^{\circ}$ or $x=120^{\circ}$

$\therefore x\in[0^{\circ}\,;\,120^{\circ}]$ OR $0^{\circ}\leq x\leq 120^{\circ}$

$\dfrac{\sin 2x\cdot\cos(-x)+\cos 2x\cdot\sin(360^{\circ}-x)}{\sin(180^{\circ}+x)}$

$=\dfrac{\sin 2x\cos x+\cos 2x(-\sin x)}{-\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\sin(2x-x)}{-\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\sin x}{-\sin x}$

$=-1$

$6\sin^2 x+7\cos x-3=0$

$6(1-\cos^2 x)+7\cos x-3=0$

$6-6\cos^2 x+7\cos x-3=0$

$6\cos^2 x-7\cos x-3=0$

$(3\cos x+1)(2\cos x-3)=0$

$\cos x=-\dfrac{1}{3}$ or $\cos x=\dfrac{3}{2}$ (N/A)

$x+\dfrac{1}{x}=3\cos A$

$(3\cos A)^2=\left(x+\dfrac{1}{x}\right)^2$

$9\cos^2 A=x^2+\dfrac{1}{x^2}+2$

$9\cos^2 A=2+2$

$\cos^2 A=\dfrac{4}{9}$

$\cos 2A=2\cos^2 A-1$

$=2\left(\dfrac{4}{9}\right)-1$

$=-\dfrac{1}{9}$
